# 2532 - Quad 80-bit static shift register (P-channel MOS)

Package DIP-16 · family MOS-shift-register · catalogue file [catalog/chips/2532.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/2532.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 62 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![2532 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/2532.png) | ![2532 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-2532.png) | ![2532 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-2532.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | OUT1 | output | totem-pole | push-pull 0..+5 V |
| 2 | REC1 | input |  | recirculate: 1 = recirculate, 0 = load IN |
| 3 | IN1 | input |  |  |
| 4 | OUT2 | output | totem-pole | push-pull 0..+5 V |
| 5 | REC2 | input |  | recirculate: 1 = recirculate, 0 = load IN |
| 6 | IN2 | input |  |  |
| 7 | OUT3 | output | totem-pole | push-pull 0..+5 V |
| 8 | VDD | ground |  | VDD (ground) |
| 9 | REC3 | input |  | recirculate: 1 = recirculate, 0 = load IN |
| 10 | IN3 | input |  |  |
| 11 | PHI_IN | clock |  | falling edge; single-phase clock common to all four registers; data entered while high, shifted when it goes low |
| 12 | VGG | power |  | -12 V |
| 13 | OUT4 | output | totem-pole | push-pull 0..+5 V |
| 14 | REC4 | input |  | recirculate: 1 = recirculate, 0 = load IN |
| 15 | IN4 | input |  |  |
| 16 | VCC | power |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | What it does |
|---|---|
| 1,4,7,13 | OUTn is the last bit of the 80-bit register n. Each clock fall shifts the register one place. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 320

Changes on: clock: data entered while PHI_IN is 1, shifted when it goes to 0

- RECn = 0: INn is written into register n
- RECn = 1: register n recirculates (output fed back), INn ignored

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 1.6 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Advance specification: sink 1.6 mA (one TTL load). Supplies +5 V and -12 V. DC to 2.5 MHz guaranteed. Inputs have internal pull-ups. |

## Not known

- The datasheet read is an ADVANCE SPECIFICATION with no electrical or timing tables: propagation delay, clock widths, setup/hold and supply tolerances are all unknown.
- Output source current not printed.

## Notes

Not the 2532 EPROM. Datasheet: pin-for-pin replacement for MK1007P and TMS3409.

## Sources

- [Signetics 1972 MOS data book, 2532 quad 80-bit static shift register (ADVANCE SPECIFICATION)](https://www.bitsavers.org/components/signetics/_dataBooks/1972_Signetics_MOS.pdf) - pdf 112-113 (printed 111-112); 2532B

## Used on sheets

No sheet in this repository uses this chip yet.
